heading: How a semester runs
paragraphs: Founded in 2025, the Data Science Club at ELTE is a beginner-friendly community. Students explore data science, AI, and machine learning through collaborative projects, guest speakers, and peer learning.
Everyone contributes at their own level. The projects give members a record of the work through GitHub contributions.
focus: Real-world applications of data science and AI
Guest speaker sessions and industry insights
Beginner-friendly exploration of AI, ML, and DS concepts
